kick.title: What Decatron records from Kick
kick.body: Kick does not provide your follower list or notify when someone unfollows. Decatron saves each new follow since this feature was turned on, but it cannot import people who already followed you or detect unfollows. If the bot is off right when someone follows you, that follow is not recorded.

guide.title: How Followers works
guide.description: What Decatron records, how often it updates and what it cannot know.
guide.step1Body: Each new follow is saved the moment it happens, with the real name and date that Twitch provides.
guide.step1BodyBoth: Each new follow is saved the moment it happens, on both Twitch and Kick. On Twitch the date is the one the platform provides; on Kick, the date of the notice.
guide.step2Title: The server checks your list every hour
guide.step2Body: Even if this page is not open, Decatron compares your followers with Twitch's list once an hour. That way it recovers follows it did not get to see, updates names that changed and detects who stopped following you. You can also do it by hand with Sync.
guide.step3Body: Twitch does not notify when someone unfollows: Decatron detects it by comparing lists, so the unfollow date is the date of that check and not necessarily the exact day. If Twitch's list arrives incomplete or too many followers are missing at once, that check marks nobody to avoid mistakes, and you will see a notice on screen.
guide.step4Body: Search for them by name in the Followers tab. If there are no results, use Look up on Twitch and in chat: it asks Twitch live whether they follow you today, and it also finds people who changed their name if they ever wrote in your chat.
guide.limit1: Who followed you and left before Decatron started recording your channel: Twitch does not provide the history of earlier followers.
guide.limit2: The exact day someone stopped following you.
guide.limitKick1: On Kick, who followed you before this feature was turned on, and who unfollows: Kick does not provide the follower list or notify unfollows.
guide.limitKick2: On Kick, follows that happen while the bot is off.
